name: Tamberlock "Flue" Gearwhistle
bio: The Hush Concord's tinker. Builds and crews the Gale Organ. Wants it to sing at full pressure at least once on camera; can be flattered or hired by someone who respects the machine.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.desc: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Machine Sense
traits.desc: Flue knows the Gale Organ's exact Pressure at all times and notices tampering automatically.

actions.name: Valve Pistol
actions.desc: Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet.

bonus_actions.name: Crank
bonus_actions.desc: Adds 1 Pressure to the Gale Organ while Flue is within 5 feet of it.

reactions.name: Reroute
reactions.desc: When the Gale Organ would discharge, Flue redirects its line by up to 45 degrees.
